name: couch-coop
description: An arcade inside Claude Code: play Doom (Freedoom) and Game Boy games in a pane, on your own or co-op with Claude.

node_path.title: Node.js path
node_path.description: Node.js 20 or newer runs the games. Leave empty to find it automatically (PATH, Homebrew, Volta, nvm).

roms_folder.title: Game Boy ROMs folder
roms_folder.description: Where your own .gb and .gbc files are. Leave empty for ~/.couch-coop/roms.

display.title: Picture
display.description: blocks: colored half-block cells, works in every terminal. pixels: real pixels in kitty and Ghostty. auto: pixels where they work.

fps.title: Frames per second
fps.description: How often the picture refreshes. Lower it if your terminal struggles.
